metadata.name: unknown
metadata.description: Unknown — a Solana launchpad where fate decides what the dev can dump

accounts.name: receipt
docs: `init` fails if it exists, so each holder claims each epoch once.

instructions.name: create_launch
docs: Creates the token with authorities burned, escrows the dev buy and rolls the dice.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Fresh keypair. Freeze authority is never set; mint authority is revoked below.

instructions.name: fog_request
docs: Draws randomness for the next fog tick.

instructions.name: fog_resolve
docs: Reveals whether this tick lifts the fog and opens trading.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: Migrates a completed curve into Raydium CPMM and burns the LP.

instructions.name: mock_fulfill
docs: Local validators only (`mock-vrf` builds): injects VRF output.

instructions.name: refund_launch
docs: Refunds the dev if the dice VRF never answered.

instructions.name: settle_launch
docs: Lands the dice: executes the dev buy and splits it into free and bound tokens.

errors.name: MetadataTooLong
errors.msg: Name, symbol or uri too long

errors.name: DevBuyOutOfRange
errors.msg: Dev buy is outside the allowed range

errors.name: InvalidState
errors.msg: Launch is not in the required state

errors.name: WrongRandomnessAccount
errors.msg: Randomness account does not match the pending request

errors.name: RandomnessNotReady
errors.msg: Randomness has not been fulfilled yet

errors.name: RequestAlreadyPending
errors.msg: A randomness request is already pending

errors.name: NotTimedOut
errors.msg: VRF request has not timed out yet

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InsufficientCurveSol
errors.msg: Not enough SOL in the curve

errors.name: ExceedsUnlocked
errors.msg: Amount exceeds the unlocked vault balance

errors.name: ExceedsUnallocated
errors.msg: Epoch total exceeds unallocated holder pool

errors.name: MockVrfDisabled
errors.msg: Mock VRF is not enabled in this build

types.name: ClaimReceipt
docs: Its existence marks (epoch, holder) as claimed.

fields.name: merkle_authority
docs: Posts holder-reward merkle roots (the indexer's key).

fields.name: cpmm_program
docs: Raydium CPMM program the curve graduates into.

fields.name: curve_supply
docs: Tokens sold on the curve; the curve completes when they are gone.

fields.name: lp_supply
docs: Tokens reserved for the DEX pool at graduation.

fields.name: migration_fee
docs: Lamports sent to `fee_recipient` at graduation.

fields.name: migration_budget
docs: Lamports handed to the migrator PDA to pay DEX pool rent and fees.

fields.name: liquid_total
docs: Freed by the dice: withdrawable at any time.

fields.name: vest_total
docs: Bound by the dice: unlocks linearly from `vest_start` over 3 hours.

fields.name: vest_start
docs: 0 until trading opens.

fields.name: staked
docs: Tokens currently held by the vault. Only these count.

fields.name: peak
docs: Highest `staked` ever. Never grows after the dev buy.

fields.name: coef_bps
docs: Share of creator fees the dev keeps, in bps. Only ever decreases.

fields.name: fee_forfeited
docs: Creator fees redirected to holders because `coef_bps` < 100%.

fields.name: real_tokens
docs: Tokens still for sale on the curve.

fields.name: dev_buy_escrow
docs: Held in `sol_vault` (with `real_sol` and a rent reserve) until settle.

fields.name: fog_deadline
docs: After this, anyone may force the fog open (liveness if nobody cranks).

types.name: MockRandomness
docs: Admin-injected randomness for local testing (`mock-vrf` builds only).
